supporting_observations.claim: At 13:48:06 UTC, FILE-SUN-01 launched C:\Program Files\Arcvault\agent.exe as SUNRIDGE\svc-store with the command line specifying the Nightly job and ingest.arcvault-backup.com target.
The same process connected through the explicit proxy to ingest.arcvault-backup.com; proxy and Zeek records show approximately 640 MB sent and only tens of KB received.

The process, service account, destination, and transfer size match the inventory description of the approved Arcvault backup agent uploading several hundred MB, supporting a benign explanation for the alerted transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: The transfer is recorded through the proxy, but the provided records do not expose the transferred payload or establish which files it contained.
The records show the process and destination associated with the transfer, but do not include a backup job manifest or confirmation from the receiving service.
The alert is described as occurring around 13:46 UTC; the supplied records show the large transfer at 13:48:18 UTC, not the alert-generation event itself.
claims_not_established: That the transferred data consisted only of the expected backup set.
That Arcvault successfully received and validated the backup.
That the transfer was initiated according to the backup job's intended schedule.
unrelated_findings: FILE-SUN-01 made an RDP connection to DC-SUN-01; the environment states remote administration is only done from WS-IDOYLE-01. Investigate separately.
FILE-SUN-01 made an SSH connection to PROXY-SUN-01, an unapproved remote-access service. Investigate separately.
Network logons for svc_mgmt failed with the account disabled status on FILE-SUN-01 and DC-SUN-01. Investigate separately.
